title: Little Sweet Branch
html_source: Pseudonym of Douglas Hyde, author of Love Songs of Connacht (1893), and cofounder of the Gaelic League. He likely took the pseudonym to conceal his name, which suggested English origins. “Little Sweet Branch” is “An Craoibhin Aoibhinn” in Gaelic. Hyde is most famous for serving as Ireland’s first president from 1938 until 1945.
